capabilities: Convert images, video and audio files to more compact formats
Reduce media quality to shrink file sizes
Roll back temporary files to originals after a failed conversion
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault before converting, and provides a rollback command to restore originals after conversion errors.
motivation: The author states most users can reduce their vault size by 70% by converting assets to more compact formats.
problem: Embedded images, videos and audio files can take up large amounts of vault storage, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to convert or recompress them.
summary: Media converter that shrinks vault size by converting images, video and audio to more compact formats via FFmpeg.
